study.question: Observed validation evidence: g3-r0008-compact_private macro AUC 0.829313966194 exceeds g3-r0008-compact_mean by 0.000434617959, with 32,982,665 parameters, 447.188 s training and 35.484 s validation inference. Width-210 private-minus-mean is 0.000568233705, but wider private AUC is lower than compact. Compact is -0.000127941362 below incumbent g3-r0006-linear_private (0.829441907556) while reducing observed wall time from 570.121 to 492.315 s. Source inspection shows task residual scores depend on target, keys and action but the residual sum has no rank dependence; shared moments alone carry signed rank. Does replacing only the compact task residual content sum with a task-weighted signed rank moment improve macro AUC, and does the improvement depend on private routing?
study.hypothesis: Task-private target/action relevance and within-prefix chronology may interact beyond the shared g0 moment representation. Retain the shared g0 content, relation counts and linear moments, but replace the direct compact residual sum R_t=sum_i s_t(i)v_i by R_t=sum_i s_t(i)z_i v_i, where z is centered RMS-normalized valid-event rank. Private-versus-mean routing crosses this basis replacement. This is a prospective information-flow/representation test with no added parameters, not a claim that a global order-blind network lacks chronology: the inherited shared token stack already contains it. All observed gains remain single-seed. Originality and generalization are unverified.

nearest_work.difference: Exact architectural parent. Retain all modules and initialization; replace only the task-residual pooling basis. All four arms switch this reduction to FP32, so content controls measure any arithmetic-path change relative to the committed source.

Ancestor source hash verified; shared 35 relation/moment tokens and their projection remain inherited through compact. Its signed rank basis is reused at the task residual readout instead of adding another shared token moment. No priority claim for the basis.

Archived exact-version primary text, lines 249-283: unnormalized target-conditioned local activation and weighted history sum. We inherit that family of relevance computation; the local difference is four action-aware residual scorers and signed-rank residual pooling alongside inherited unified tokens. No exact original-paper reproduction claim.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 123-170 initializes task hubs using historical task masks and processes them through layer-wise interactions. This candidate does not add task-mask hubs or broadcasts; it replaces a direct signed-rank pooling basis. Benchmark code equivalence to the unavailable original INFNet paper is not established.

Cached primary benchmark section 2.3 describes TokenFormer full/windowed token attention, UniMixer flattening and OneTrans repeated interaction. None is reproduced here; the inherited compact token stack stays fixed. Original-method priority remains unaudited.

Registry supplies the author README only and reports publisher full text unavailable; position-related mechanism cannot be checked from its nine-line text. No DMR mechanism or novelty distinction is asserted.

study.proposed_difference: Only the direct task residual pooling basis changes. For N valid events, compute c_i=2*r_i-N+1 (r_i starts at zero), z_i=c_i/sqrt(mean_valid(c^2)); clamp the denominator to 1e-6. Invalid positions have zero coefficient. Linear arms use z; content controls use the visibility indicator. For N=0 or N=1 the signed moment is exactly zero. All four arms compute both bases, four scores, private/mean routing, FP32 basis multiplication and residual bmm, then cast to the inherited value dtype. Shared token moments remain linear in EVERY arm; task_pool_mode is distinct from moment_mode. Private/mean preserves identical capacity and forward operators; each contrast changes only one config factor. No learned projection, tower change, position embedding or extra loss is added.
predictions: Primary quality contrast: task_moment_private minus task_content_private macro AUC > 0 on the full validation split. The new candidate must also beat g0-r0005-linear_moment (0.828326273496); report whether it beats the current incumbent 0.829441907556 before selecting it.

Task-specific chronology predicts positive interaction I=(AUC(task_moment_private)-AUC(task_content_private))-(AUC(task_moment_mean)-AUC(task_content_mean)). Positive moment main effect with I near zero supports only a generic residual representation change, not synergy with task conditioning.

Parameter count should be exactly the committed compact count 32,982,665 (31,793,216 embedding; 1,189,449 dense). Added work is deterministic rank arithmetic over B*100 plus casting/residual FP32 accumulation, with the same B*4*112 residual output and no new sequence attention.

Predeclared diagnostics, if the host supports authorized validation slices: history counts 0, 1, 2-9, 10-49, 50-100; report sample and positive/negative counts for each task. Signed residual vanishes at counts 0 and 1, with possible value concentrated in longer histories. Training changes global parameters, so no prediction-equality claim across trained models for short histories.

Host structural checks: inherited parameter/buffer/RNG initialization should match compact (ignoring model ID); all new arms start at the same prediction function because scorer outputs are zero. Isolated residual content pooling is invariant to consistent valid-event permutation, while its signed moment negates under reversal in eval mode. The full model is already order-aware, so this is a branch diagnostic only.
falsifiers: No repeated positive moment-private minus content-private contrast, regression below g0, or gains offset by unacceptable measured quality/cost trade-offs oppose useful task-residual chronology. Do not promote a candidate on a favorable individual task if macro AUC falls.
A nonpositive interaction or a comparable moment effect with mean routing leaves task-specific complementarity unsupported even if generic moment pooling wins.

If FP32 content controls shift quality by as much as the proposed gain relative to compact, no gain versus the old source can be assigned to chronology without the within-round contrasts. If padding junk/current-action perturbations change outputs or gradients become nonfinite, execution is invalid rather than scientific counterevidence.

A local failure only rejects this signed-residual replacement implementation under the frozen one-pass recipe; it does not refute all task-conditioned chronology. Budget-permitting discriminating follow-up: preserve content and add a separately projected signed residual, or compare centered quadratic/rank-permuted bases to distinguish chronology from cancellation. No sign-flip-only ablation: its sign is absorbable.

All current trial records are successful; no failed trial or error is supplied (previous_runtime_error is null). Do not invent a failure. Unavailable torch, raw data, original paper text and slice diagnostics are missing prerequisites/evidence, not negative scientific outcomes.
alternative_explanations: Moment pooling changes cancellation, residual norm and the gradient distribution in addition to event order. Coefficient RMS normalization controls basis scale for N>=2 but does not match representation/gradient norms. Content versus linear plus private versus mean does not isolate every statistical effect of centering; a positive interaction is provisional, not a mechanism proof.

Signed moments eliminate the residual for single-event histories and may discard useful task-specific content. Shared direct content and shared token moments remain, but loss of the residual content channel could explain a null/negative result.

Private/mean comparisons are equal in parameters, yet task-private coupling changes loss specialization. A gain could arise from optimization rather than a distinct preserved chronological statistic. Independent paired-seed confirmation and branch diagnostics are required.

Review of prior branches: g3-r0006-linear_private exceeds linear_mean by 0.000361571; copy_private exceeds copy_mean by 0.000574461, so their difference-in-differences is approximately -0.000212890 and does not establish positive shared-moment/private synergy. Both copy controls underperform the linear/private incumbent. These are matched local contrasts at one seed, not independent replications.

Gradient-stop factorial g3-r0007-linear_grad_open, linear_click_stop_replay, linear_aux_stop and linear_both_stop spans only about 0.000074081 macro AUC. Exact same-seed click-stop replay reproduces the parent score but is not a new seed. No gradient-isolation benefit is established; this study keeps gradients open.

The width-210 private and mean controls cost more and score below their width-64 analogues. They oppose a simple more-scorer-capacity explanation within this lineage, but they do not establish an equal-compute optimum. All new contrasts match exposure; measured wall time/inference and the observed quality-cost frontier must be reported separately.

Selection across earlier variants can overfit validation; none of these observations is withheld evidence. Historical auxiliary labels are category/brand 24h matches rather than advertisement conversion attribution; official-offline feedback availability and static snapshots limit production transfer.
